name: empty-nest-transition
description:
Produces structured transition frameworks for parents whose children are
leaving home, covering logistics like health insurance transitions and
financial independence milestones alongside personal adjustment frameworks
for redesigning daily routines, relationship dynamics, and personal identity
beyond the parenting role.
Use when the user asks about adjusting to children leaving home, empty nest
syndrome, or transitioning when kids go to college or move out.
Do NOT use for college financial planning (use personal-finance skills),
clinical depression treatment (consult a therapist), or child-focused
college preparation (use education skills).
